name: Unpaywall_check_oa_status
description: Query a DOI in Unpaywall with DOI normalization and returned-identity verification. Returns the complete source record plus convenience OA status fields, all current and embargoed OA locations, evidence, licenses, repository institutions, authors, journal flags, and explicit location counts. Requires a valid contact email.

doi.description: DOI (Digital Object Identifier) of the article to check for open access status.

email.description: Contact email address required by Unpaywall API for polite usage tracking.

name: Unpaywall_get_full_text_url
description: Retrieve full-text and landing-page URLs from Unpaywall after normalizing and verifying the DOI. Returns the best location plus every full 13-field OA location record (including evidence, OA date, endpoint/PMH IDs, repository institution, update date, license and version), embargoed locations, and the complete source record. No location qualifiers are silently projected away.

doi.description: DOI (Digital Object Identifier) of the article, e.g. '10.1038/nature12373'.

email.description: Contact email for Unpaywall API polite pool. Defaults to 'tools@tooluniverse.org' if not provided.
